title: The Eruption of Vesuvius in 1872
author: Luigi Palmieri

authorInfo.bio: Luigi Palmieri (1807–1896) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Eruption of Vesuvius in 1872" by Professor Luigi Palmieri is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. The book documents Palmieri's firsthand observations and analyses of the volcanic eruption of Mount Vesuvius, detailing the physical phenomena associated with the eruption while also discussing broader themes related to volcanology and seismology.
